[FI] They are Kuroneko's younger sisters, who I got to 
know during this summer.
[FI] How this situation came to be is easy to explain.
[FI] I happened to meet them in town, by chance.

[FI] And thus, I got forcibly dragged by Hinata-chan by 
the sleeve and brought here-
[FI] It was the starting point, so to speak.

TEXT: [FI] You need life counseling? From me?
[FI] Counseling with my friend's cute little sisters.

[FI] If it's something I can do, I would do anything for 
them.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Yes, but we still don't know if this person is going to 
be useful.

TEXT: [FI] You can't fool me by laughing.

sorry.

TEXT:

Kuroneko's manner of speech now.

TEXT: [FI] Hey, Hinata-chan. What's up with her?

TEXT: [FI] Ruri-nee has been acting a little weird lately.

TEXT: [FI] Your sister's always acting weird, though?

TEXT:
[FI] It's nothing like that. This time, it's different from her 
usual self.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] And she isn't getting better. She's always like that, 
the whole time at home, too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...Kukuku... Detestable, how detestable, it is so 
detestable.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Perhaps now, my black-stained heart may be able 
to destroy the world.

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] Onee-sama's heart exists in deep darkness.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] It's also being a bad influence on Tamaki.

TEXT: [FI] Can't you do something about it?

TEXT:
